plans.executive_summary: Standalone attack incident covering the brute-force attempt against root from external IP 203.0.113.35 targeting ssh-srv.

immediate_actions.action: Block source IP address at firewall

investigation_steps: Review SSH authentication logs on ssh-srv for additional failed attempts from 203.0.113.35.
Verify if any root login attempts were successful.
prevention: Disable direct root login via SSH.
Enforce robust password policies and multi-factor authentication.

plans.executive_summary: Standalone port scanning incident from external source IP 203.0.113.188 against ssh-srv.

immediate_actions.action: Block source IP address at firewall

investigation_steps: Check firewall and IDS logs for further reconnaissance activity originating from 203.0.113.188.
Inspect open ports and running services on ssh-srv.
prevention: Implement network intrusion detection systems to identify and block active scanning early.
Ensure unused ports are closed or firewalled.

plans.executive_summary: Chronologically linked attack chain originating from 203.0.113.188 leading to successful credential access on deploy, privilege escalation via sudo, and outbound data exfiltration.

immediate_actions.action: Terminate active sessions for user deploy

investigation_steps: Examine sudo logs and auth logs to trace all actions performed by user deploy after privilege escalation.
Investigate outbound network connections and destination details for the large data transfer on port 4444.
Perform forensic disk and memory analysis on ssh-srv to check for persistence mechanisms.
prevention: Audit and restrict sudo privileges for service accounts like deploy.
Implement egress filtering and data loss prevention controls.
Require multi-factor authentication for all remote access.

plans.executive_summary: Standalone credential spraying incident from external source IP 203.0.113.117 targeting multiple internal users.

immediate_actions.action: Block source IP address at firewall
Audit targeted user accounts for compromise
immediate_actions.target: akhan, asharma, deploy, mshah, npatel, pmehta, rkumar, srao

investigation_steps: Review authentication logs across all hosts for successful logins associated with the targeted user accounts during the attack window.
Check for anomalous account behavior or unauthorized access.
prevention: Implement account lockout and rate-limiting policies for authentication endpoints.
Enforce multi-factor authentication across all user accounts.

plans.executive_summary: Standalone web application exploitation incident involving SQL injection and sqlmap vulnerability scanning against web-srv from external source IP 203.0.113.112.

immediate_actions.action: Block source IP address at web firewall

mitigations.name: Limit Access to Resource Over Network

investigation_steps: Analyze web server access and error logs for successful SQL injection exploitation or database compromise indicators.
Inspect web application source code and database query logs.
prevention: Implement parameterized queries and input validation across all web applications.
Deploy a Web Application Firewall (WAF) to detect and block SQL injection attempts.

plans.executive_summary: Standalone discovery and path traversal incident attempting to read sensitive system files such as /etc/passwd on web-srv from external source IP 203.0.113.64.

immediate_actions.action: Block source IP address at firewall

investigation_steps: Review web server logs to determine if any sensitive files were successfully accessed or exfiltrated during the directory traversal attempts.
prevention: Ensure proper input sanitization and path normalization in web applications to prevent directory traversal.
Apply principle of least privilege regarding file system permissions for web application processes.
